marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Capital Expenditure & Semiconductors
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported sustained double-digit growth in quarterly capital expenditure targeting high-performance AI chips and data center infrastructure.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor design, advanced packaging, and optical communication hardware suppliers are likely to maintain high revenue visibility into upcoming quarters.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Commercial monetization pace of enterprise AI applications and potential hardware supply bottlenecks.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & Tech Sector Rebound
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index gained momentum as leading platform enterprises announced expanded share buyback initiatives alongside new cloud AI partnerships.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced capital return programs provide valuation support for major HK-listed internet equities, improving risk reward profiles for long-term institutional investors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumer spending recovery and evolving regulatory frameworks around cross-border data flows.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy Expectations & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Softening labor market indicators and inline US core inflation figures reinforced market consensus for an upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate cut.
marketLayer.inference: Lower Treasury yields ease cost-of-capital pressures on growth equities and may trigger capital reallocations into undervalued emerging market assets, benefiting HK market liquidity.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky services inflation or geopolitical commodity price spikes that could disrupt the anticipated easing trajectory.
